R. Q. 1 سَبْسَبَ (assumed tropical:) He severed his tie, or ties, of relationship, by unkind behaviour to his kindred. (AA.) ＝
-A2- He went a gentle pace. (AA. [Freytag, on the authority of “ Hamak. Waked., ” assigns this meaning to ↓ تَسَبْسَبَ .]) ＝
-A3- He smelt a foul smell. (AA.) ＝
-A4- He discharged his urine. (M, K.) He made water to flow. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
